html:
G'oya

(product, price) juftliklarini ikki to'plam deb qarang. Qo'shilganlar: bugungi to'plamdan kechagisini ayirish. O'chirilganlar: aksincha. Ikkala natijaga yorliq qo'yib, ustma-ust qo'yamiz.

Yechim

SELECT 'qo''shilgan' AS change, product, price
FROM (SELECT product, price FROM prices_today
      EXCEPT
      SELECT product, price FROM prices_yesterday) a
UNION ALL
SELECT 'o''chirilgan', product, price
FROM (SELECT product, price FROM prices_yesterday
      EXCEPT
      SELECT product, price FROM prices_today) d

Namunada Sut 12000 dan 13000 ga qimmatlagan. ('Sut', 13000) kechagi ro'yxatda yo'q, demak qo'shilgan. ('Sut', 12000) bugungisida yo'q, demak o'chirilgan. Narxi o'zgargan mahsulot uchun alohida shart yozish shart emas.

Tuzoqlar

NULL narx. EXCEPT ikkita NULLni teng deb hisoblaydi, oddiy = va <> esa yo'q. Mahsulot bo'yicha JOIN qilib, y.price <> t.price deb yozsangiz, Asal (kecha NULL, bugun 60000) o'zgarmagandek ko'rinadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT 'qo''shilgan' AS change, t.product, t.price
FROM prices_today t LEFT JOIN prices_yesterday y ON y.product = t.product
WHERE y.product IS NULL OR y.price <> t.price
UNION ALL
SELECT 'o''chirilgan', y.product, y.price
FROM prices_yesterday y LEFT JOIN prices_today t ON t.product = y.product
WHERE t.product IS NULL OR t.price <> y.price

Yorliqni EXCEPTdan oldin qo'shib bo'lmaydi: ('qo''shilgan', 'Non', 4000) va ('o''chirilgan', 'Non', 4000) har xil qatorlar, ular bir-birini ayirmaydi va o'zgarmagan Non ham natijaga chiqadi.

Faqat mahsulot nomini solishtirish (product NOT IN (...)) yangi va olib tashlangan mahsulotlarni topadi, lekin narx o'zgarishini ko'rmaydi.
